title: Reproduce before guessing
subtitle: Turn a vague complaint into diagnostic evidence.
concept: Record environment, actions, actual and expected results. Reproduce reliably, narrow the failing data stage and make a minimal fix.
intuition: If one tap has no water, check whether other taps work before dismantling the house.
objectives: Record environment, steps, actual and expected behavior and original errors.
Retest the failure and nearby boundaries, recording cause and evidence.

body.title: Preserve the first error
body.text: Record directory, command, URL, input and full error. Browser Console shows script errors; Network shows requests. Screenshots help, but text and steps are easier to reproduce. Replace credentials and private log content with descriptive placeholders before sharing.

body.title: Test one hypothesis
body.text: Refresh loss might mean failed saving, failed loading or changed origin. Inspect one hypothesis at a time: same URL, write errors, matching keys. Ask for the next check that distinguishes causes. Changing ten things obscures the cause and can introduce side effects.

body.title: Retest the original and neighboring cases
body.text: After a minimal fix, repeat the failure and related cases: ordinary saving, whitespace rejection and invalid backup preservation. Record cause, fix, checks and remaining issues. Abandon guesses contradicted by evidence. Swallowing exceptions is not success; users need to know data was not saved.

formalDefinition.text: Record environment, actions, actual and expected results. Reproduce reliably, narrow the failing data stage and make a minimal fix.
conditions: For small personal learning projects. In shared repositories, follow the team's conventions.
This method produces checkable evidence; it cannot guarantee arbitrary AI output is correct.

workflow: Record environment, steps, actual and expected behavior and original errors.
Test one hypothesis along the data path to narrow the cause.
Retest the failure and nearby boundaries, recording cause and evidence.

workedExamples.title: Data disappears on refresh
workedExamples.problem: What diagnostic material should the agent receive?
steps: Give persistence expectations and the original console error.
workedExamples.answer: Environment: http://127.0.0.1:5180 locally. Add Learn Git, confirm it appears, then refresh. Actual: empty list. Expected: retained item. Original console error attached. Distinguish save failure, load failure and origin changes before rewriting anything.

workedExamples.title: Storage is blocked
workedExamples.problem: Should a saving exception be caught and reported as success?
steps: Observe the write did not persist.
Keep the previous reliable state and report not saved.
When storage works, verify refresh again.
workedExamples.answer: Do not claim saved. Handle failure visibly and distinguish memory changes from persisted data. This example updates the displayed list only after a successful write; failure preserves the previous state.

commonMistakes.claim: If a fix fails, rewrite everything.
commonMistakes.correction: Reproduce and narrow first; a rewrite discards already-verified behavior.

commonMistakes.claim: Hiding errors makes the app stable.
commonMistakes.correction: Suppressed exceptions can silently lose data. Give understandable feedback.

practice.problem: Expand the report saving is broken.
practice.answer: URL and environment, steps, actual versus expected results, and original errors.
solution: Enable another person to reproduce it.
Give evidence, not only a conclusion.

practice.problem: The list is empty after changing ports. What first?
practice.answer: Check origin changes. Ports have separate localStorage and do not migrate automatically.
solution: Expected isolation does not mean all persistence code is broken.

practice.problem: Five simultaneous edits made it work. What is missing?
practice.answer: The cause is unclear and other edits may have side effects. Narrow the diff and verify each part.
solution: Temporary disappearance of the symptom is insufficient.

practice.problem: What should be checked after a persistence fix?
practice.hint: The original case and nearby failures.
practice.answer: Refresh reproduction, ordinary creation, whitespace rejection, write-failure feedback and invalid-import preservation.
solution: Avoid fixing one behavior while breaking another.
Choose boundaries related to the change.

learningCheck.question: Which debugging request is useful?
choices: Environment, steps, actual/expected results and original errors
feedback: Scope is broad before the cause is known.

interactiveVisual.prediction: Refresh loss has three plausible causes. How do you narrow them?

steps.question: Ports differ before and after refresh. What first?
feedback: The port change itself may explain missing records.
There is no evidence for rewriting all code.

steps.question: A write definitely throws. What should the page do?
choices: Report not saved and retain reliable state
feedback: Success would contradict the write result.
State the failure without misleading the user.

steps.question: The fix now works. What next?
choices: Repeat the original and related boundary checks
feedback: Confirm the fix and inspect side effects.

interactiveVisual.followUp: Choose a reproducible problem, write its report and distinguish confirmed facts from open hypotheses.
